environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed in VPC with standard NAT gateway for internet access. Lambda execution role has s3:CopyObject, s3:GetObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:PutObject permissions with Resource: '*'. The function is invoked via API Gateway with Cognito authorizer. No VPC endpoints configured - all S3 traffic routes through NAT gateway to public S3 endpoints. Default STAGING_BUCKET is 'company-staging-prod'. No bucket policy restrictions on destination buckets.
